description: Portal testchmb_a_02, first test room at (-448 150 0): open a blue portal on the portalable wall at yaw 90 and an orange one on the facing wall at yaw 270, look at each, then walk into the blue portal; the orange exit faces the blue portal, so walking on crosses the pair repeatedly. Then walk into the orange portal. Every pass first fizzles both portals, so each pass opens new portals. Frames come from the native Vulkan renderer (-vkframestats); budgets gate the last (warm) pass.
